headline: ASK Automotive Limited: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Vijay Rathee and associates filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Code with NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in ASK Automotive Limited, an automotive component manufacturer listed on NSE/BSE.
detail: The disclosure was submitted to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The filers-Vijay Rathee, Kuldip Singh Rathee, Prashant Rathee, Aman Rathee, Kanika Rathee, Vijeta Rathee, and Sarla Chahal-represent either individuals acting in concert or members of a promoter/acquiring group. The specific percentage acquired, consideration, and conditions precedent are not disclosed in the available filings; the full disclosure document would contain details on shareholding, concert parties, and financing.
